entries.effect: each Universal MIDI Packet word of type 2 (MIDI 1.0 channel voice) is sent as one MusicDeviceMIDIEvent with its status and data bytes, in order; words of other message types (system, MIDI 2.0 channel voice, SysEx, utility) are skipped, because this release has no call that can send them
